claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: SB-366791 is a potent and selective TRPV1 antagonist with no reported cytotoxic or antiproliferative activity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive against cancer cell lines.

raw.cytotoxic_mechanism: SB-366791 is a potent and selective TRPV1 antagonist with no reported cytotoxic or antiproliferative activity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive against cancer cell lines.
